evals.prompt: 帮我用豆包生成一张后末日风格的装甲车图片，要有沙漠背景和戏剧性光影效果，保存到 ./test_outputs/vehicle.png
evals.expected_output: An image file saved to ./test_outputs/vehicle.png showing a post-apocalyptic armored vehicle in a desert setting
expectations: The script generate_image.py was executed via uv run
The API response indicates success status
The prompt was written in a descriptive way suitable for image generation

evals.prompt: I need a pixel art game sprite of a raider character, top-down view, 64x64 pixels. Use Seedream 5.0 and save it to ./test_outputs/raider_sprite.png
evals.expected_output: A pixel art sprite image saved to ./test_outputs/raider_sprite.png
expectations: The script generate_image.py was used with --version 5.0 flag
The prompt includes pixel art and game sprite related keywords
The size parameter was appropriate for the chosen version (2K or 3K for v5.0)

evals.expected_output: A video generation task submitted, with task_id returned and instructions to poll for completion
expectations: The script generate_video.py was executed via uv run
The duration was set to 5 seconds
